verdict.rationale: Salv's Cases product documents opening a case, giving it an assignee and a status, and working it with notes and documents. That covers assignment and basic status tracking. There is no evidence of defined analyst-review and escalation stages or of routing cases between those stages. missing for 10: documented multi-stage review/escalation workflow, routing or reassignment rules between stages, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a operations-lead, I can assign cases and route them through analyst review and escalation stages

citations.quote: Open a case, attach the related alerts, customers and transactions, and work it with notes, documents, an assignee and a status
